City Opens New Science Library

By Priya Raman

September 14, 2023

The city opened its new science library on the harbour front on Thursday, with two hundred thousand books, a public laboratory and reading rooms that stay open until midnight on weekdays.

"We wanted a place where anyone can come and try things," the head librarian said at the opening, which drew a crowd of several hundred people despite the rain.

Opening hours
DayHours
Weekdays8–24
Weekends10–18

The building cost less than planned, according to figures released by the council earlier this month.
